annotations.title: Compare server prices by region and play schedule

description: Returns estimated monthly prices in US cents, as the site shows them, for every available region and size under three play schedules (casual, regular, evenings), plus always-on host references when available. Name each size by its memoryGb, adding vcpu when two sizes share the same memory; the size value is only for createServer. The hourly price the site shows for a size is its lowest monthlyCents divided by hoursPerMonth across the schedules, rounded to a whole cent and never below 1 cent. Use it to quote prices or choose region and size: pass a region's id (not awsRegion) as createServer region, and a size as size. Works without sign-in.
name: getPricingCatalog
